# Germany, Lower Saxony/Bremen/Hamburg — 2025

> Benchmark chips for Germany-NDS cut from the 2025 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection de_nds.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/de_nds_2025_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/de_nds_2025_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/de_nds_2025_fields.parquet)
- [Field polygons after the class filter](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/de_nds_2025_fields_filtered.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/de_nds_2025/items.parquet)
